description: Presidential Secretariat - Regulations No. 01 of 2021 - Supply of Essential Goods
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the President under the Public Security Ordinance, establishing legal frameworks for essential food distribution during emergencies. It creates new regulatory provisions, defines legal terms, and establishes enforcement mechanisms, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions the President's authority, it does not focus on government structural changes or personnel appointments, but rather on creating legal instruments and regulatory frameworks.
